question: Can captions show a doorbell?
description: Recognize sounds in Captio AI on iPhone writes sounds around you into live captions, like [doorbell rings].
Captio AI was made for deaf and hard of hearing people, who may not hear a doorbell from the next room.
Captio AI on iPhone can show a doorbell, an alarm, a crying baby, a barking dog, laughter or music in captions.
Alert sounds make the iPhone vibrate while Captio AI is running captions.
Captio AI hears sounds only while captions run or a chosen file is transcribed, and can miss some, so it is not an always-on alarm.
Some melodic electronic door chimes sound like music to Captio AI, while a classic ding-dong doorbell is recognized.
You can change sound captions in Captio AI under Settings, Recognize sounds.
Captio AI is free to download on iPhone, with 100 free credits a day on the free plan.
